g.text: B300: aligned workloads and pipeline variants
Bars/lines: median of round means; whiskers/bands: observed round range, not confidence intervals.
Refinement uses saved console round means; per-call samples/telemetry were not retrieved.
Historical and new bars come from different GPU sessions; small differences are not causal evidence.
